args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays, high severity). 2.9.4 is the
nearest release with the fix on the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Fixed in the 2.x line as of **2.9.4** (also fixed in 3.1.0 for the 3.x line).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
